title: To amend the Research and Development, Competition, and Innovation Act to support nucleic acid screening, and for other purposes.
last_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
status: Passed House; referred to Senate Commerce
summary: Directs NIST to develop technical standards and best practices for nucleic-acid synthesis screening and for engineering-biology risks, expressly including risks associated with AI. The House-passed version authorizes $5 million annually for FY2027–FY2031.
committee_dynamics: The bill translates AI-enabled biological risk into a concrete screening and standards program. House passage gives it a stronger procedural position than most standalone AI bills, although it still requires Senate action.
advance_rationale: A filed House report and direct national-security/biosecurity rationale make material advancement comparatively likely.
